chapters.label: The late run, live
chapters.text: Bilbao, the 2024 Champions League final, in stoppage time. Barcelona lead Lyon one-nil. Ona Batlle breaks forward and finds Clàudia Pina on the left. Alexia Putellas, on for just three minutes, runs into the box. Pina passes. Goal!

chapters.label: Timing the run
chapters.text: Watch again. Alexia starts in midfield, then bursts forward as Pina gets the ball.

chapters.label: Just in time
chapters.text: She arrives just as the ball does, and crashes it high into the net with her left foot!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Time your run from midfield, so you arrive just as the ball does.
